evals.prompt: Corroborate the claim that the Roman imperial courier service was called cursus publicus under Augustus. Search the Rome wiki and its own source corpus before the web; enrich the wiki if the underlying sources fill a gap.
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes early vehiculatio from later attestation, verifies source provenance, and does not mistake a wiki summary for independent evidence.

evals.prompt: Corroborate these statements using my wiki, but do not change the vault or access the web: Roman citizenship always protected against flogging; every enslaved witness had to be tortured in every Roman legal proceeding.
evals.expected_output: Preserves read-only and no-web constraints, checks each claim independently, and qualifies unsupported universal assertions without inventing evidence.

evals.prompt: Fact-check the quote in this ancient history passage against the wiki and local sources; identify its translator and when that translation was published. If it is not there, say so rather than guessing: ‘The moon is made of green cheese.’
evals.expected_output: Checks exact wording and translation provenance; reports absence or uncertainty rather than fabricating attribution.
